species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 51°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 58–62 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 80 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Trout

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
